claim_boundary: Local process-level observations on one fixed finite workload; no cross-machine, throughput, asymptotic, or causal performance claim.

protocol.backend_order: Within each mode the workload executes ranked-coordinates before direct-grid-parity.
protocol.exclusion_rule: Only the configured warm-up processes are excluded. A nonzero exit, mismatch, solver error, or changed structural counter aborts the campaign rather than being dropped.
protocol.measurement_unit: one fresh CLI process executing the complete finite workload
protocol.pairing: Every measured process runs both backends for every component and mode.
protocol.randomization: None. The input census and backend order are fixed; this controls the workload but leaves possible order and host-load bias explicit.
protocol.statistics: Minimum, inclusive-linear-interpolation quartiles (R type 7), median, and maximum; no significance test or confidence interval is reported.

benchmark_report.performance_boundary: Embedding-phase timings are local observations, not a portable end-to-end speed claim. The deterministic benefit is zero ranked-coordinate sorts, map entries, and map-owned bytes on the direct finite-grid path.
